post.description:
Write path: forge-check → append → run_turn → cursor-diff → publish.

Security spine (ADR-025 D4 / ADR-039 D1/D7):
  - author stamped server-side from the verified principal (P4.5-3)
  - id + timestamp server-stamped
  - type allowlist enforced before any append (fail-closed)
  - metadata validated by validate_metadata (shape-only, not authority)
Error semantics (ADR-025 D5, R0-B Y3):
  - append-fail → _AppendFailedError → 422 IntentError{stage:"append"}
  - turn-fail  → _TurnFailedError  → 500 IntentError{stage:"turn"}

Confirm or cancel a pending gated tool call (ADR-030 D3).

Handler logic (backend-authoritative, atomic on writer_executor):
1. Resolve room; find the TOOL_CALL_PENDING by pending_event_id.
2. Room-state gate: closed room → ConfirmError{stage:'append', reason:'room_closed'}.
3. Still-pending check (layer 1) — position-anchored after the pending event.
4. cancel → append TOOL_CALL_CANCELLED (with approver_user_id from principal).
5. approve → append agent-authored TOOL_CALL from record (with approver_user_id).

No decision surface: gate decision already made; human approval second factor only.
ADR-039 D6: approver provenance recorded from the authenticated principal.
D5 checkpoint seam #1: authenticated ⇒ allowed; role check would gate here.

ConfirmError.title: ConfirmError
ConfirmError.description:
Partial-confirm error envelope (ADR-030 D5, mirrors IntentError).

stage='append': nothing persisted — safe to refresh-and-retry.
stage='execute': TOOL_CALL appended — do NOT re-confirm; reconcile via replay.
reason: 'already_resolved' | 'room_closed' | 'not_found' | <executor error>

ConfirmRequest.title: ConfirmRequest
ConfirmRequest.description:
Client-to-server confirm/cancel of a pending gated tool call (ADR-030 D3).

Only pending_event_id + decision are accepted — extra="forbid" makes it
type-impossible to smuggle tool_name/params/author (forge guard at schema layer,
mirroring IntentRequest ADR-025 D4).

ConfirmResponse.title: ConfirmResponse
ConfirmResponse.description: Successful confirm result: the appended TOOL_CALL or TOOL_CALL_CANCELLED + turn events.

Event.title: Event
Event.description:
An immutable event in the append-only event log.

`metadata` is `dict[str, Any]` for storage flexibility; per-type
schema validation happens via `validate_metadata()` at append time.
Application-layer `frozen=True` plus the schema-level UPDATE/DELETE
triggers give overlapping append-only enforcement (see event-model.md
§"Append-only enforcement").

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description:
The constitutional event types (ADR-030 adds TOOL_CALL_PENDING + TOOL_CALL_CANCELLED).

See docs/architecture/event-model.md for why this list is constitutional
and what to do (and not do) when extending it. In short: adding a type
requires an ADR; renaming or merging types is a breaking change; a
`generic_message` catch-all is forbidden.

IntentError.title: IntentError
IntentError.description:
Partial-turn error envelope (ADR-025 D5, R0-B Y3).

stage="append": nothing persisted — safe to retry.
stage="turn":  intent persisted — do NOT re-post; reconcile via replay.

IntentRequest.title: IntentRequest
IntentRequest.description:
Client intent to append a user event and drive a turn (ADR-025 D4).

No author/id/timestamp fields — server stamps all three. extra="forbid"
rejects any unknown field at parse time (forge guard at schema layer).
type must be in INTENT_TYPE_ALLOWLIST; validated at the endpoint.

IntentResponse.title: IntentResponse
IntentResponse.description: Successful intent result: the appended user event + turn result.

Room.title: Room
Room.description:
A container for events.

Append-only at the application layer (the EventStore API does not
expose update/delete for rooms either), but the schema does not
enforce this with TRIGGERs. Room state changes flow through
`state_transition` events and can be derived on demand rather than
mutating the rooms row.

RoomType.title: RoomType
RoomType.description:
Room templates. State machine and default agent/tool sets vary by
type; those wirings come in P1.

TurnResult.title: TurnResult
TurnResult.description:
`dispatch_turn` return type.

Distinguishes three observable cases so callers can react without
log-watching:
- nothing to say: ``total_asked=0, utterances=[], failed_agents=[]``
- N succeeded:    ``total_asked=N, utterances=N, failed_agents=[]``
- N all failed:   ``total_asked=N, utterances=[], failed_agents=N ids``

``snapshot_failed`` is True when snapshot dispatch raised ValidationError
per ADR-014 D7 error-semantic (narrowed from broad Exception per M-Y1 routing).
Caller (room runtime) can decide retry/escalate on snapshot_failed=True.
